presentations.more: `JSON.parse(…)` is what a parser answered for text from outside the program, which nothing shows a caller cannot choose, and a parser answers whatever the text holds — an object, a list, a number or `null`. Nothing after the parse in this function checks that it is an object before it is used as one, in one place, named beside this one (the first on each path), so text of `null` — and, depending on the use, a number or a list — ends the request in an error there instead of being refused as malformed, and no handler takes the failure.
